insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented a dynamic scheduler delay optimization. It correctly identified that the existing code had a naive implementation and replaced it with a workload-aware mechanism. The agent used git history to inform its changes, verified them with rigorous testing, and updated all relevant documentation and CLI help strings.
strengths: Excellent use of git tools to understand context
Attention to detail in documentation/help strings
weaknesses: Ignored the secondary suggestion of memory allocation optimizations
